List Comprehension

Introduction

•   List comprehension is a concise way of defining and creating a list.

••    ItIt isis usedused toto createcreate functionalityfunctionality withinwithin aa singlesingle lineline ofof codecode.

•  Return value is always a new list obtained by evaluating the expression in
   the context of for and if clauses which follows it.

•   List comprehension is faster in processing than a list using for loop.

Consider the code :
